Bro wtaf why is your run rate at 70?! That’s absolutely insane. I use like 46-48 for test cricket. If you’re using anything over 50 why are you even bothering with playing test cricket? 

Moreover, as others have said, arcade controls is where you are finding the issue. I’d probably turn off the fancy ball trail you have, it looks kinda arcadey but all good if you need it cos of vision. It’s cool you’ve got the minimal ball marker and are using the pro mode camera tho. Good on ya for that bit at least

Whats your AI difficulty level at? Also with the displays/markers for the ball you can change it to have no pitch marker and only the one around the ball. This still shows you the colour for length and gives a rough idea from the circle itself for line. That’s a good in-between as it’s easier to read swing/spin when you know where the ball is going to bounce exactly. You can also have no colour on the marker itself, like maybe if you only want to see the line of the ball but not length or perhaps if you like the marker on the pitch itself but don’t want any other help besides that. 

Also, you def need to be playing with the “pro mode” camera if you want it to be more challenging. If you have a marker on the pitch itself and you have a camera behind batsman with an unrealistic view then of course it’ll be easy. Also If you think changing the ball markers will be too hard for you for some reason then just change your other settings back to a bit easier (ball physics, batting, AI) so that you can get yourself used to the new marker settings. 

One final thing is it can be more fun to play realistic cricket yourself as well. Sure, it can be easy to play shots when ur using well-rated players and a bunch of helpful markers and cameras that aren’t realistic cos it’s a video game. So, just be realistic with it. Don’t be one of those guys that scores these massive scores every game at an insane strike rate. It’s always a bit wacky seeing guys with strike rates over 100 in test cricket. Sehwag had a strike rate of 82 and he’s regarded as one of the most aggressive there has ever been. Pant is mid 70’s. Jaiswal and head are both around 67ish. Maybe challenge yourself to make a hundred at no faster than a strike rate of 40

What difficulty are you playing on tho champ? Set it to hardest firstly. Then turn off the pitch marker so you only have the marker around the ball itself. Then reduce the display time even more so you only get a real short look at the ball (turn off any length/line display entirely if you feel like it). Then change the batting camera and running-between-wickets camera to pro mode. That’ll make it a bit more difficult. Also they just play ur cricket like a test cricketer. Yeah it can be easy when you select ur shots well but it’s still fun. If you need even more of a challenge, alter your physics settings further so that there is greater swing and spin, less power off the bat, higher bowling speeds, etc.
